_comment: Product source files permitted to exceed the 1000-line limit. POLICY-OWNED: the contents are set by
the reviewer, not inferred from whatever happens to be oversized today. Adding a path here is a
decision; removing one is just bookkeeping after a file is cleared.
Approved by comms-senior-dev on 2026-08-13, verbatim: 'Allowlist should be explicit and policy-owned,
not inferred from whatever is currently oversized. The currently justified product allowlist is the
ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH, read by both gates -- service/tests/test_no_new_oversized_source_file.py and
mcp/stdio/tests/no-new-oversized-source-file.test.js. Two copies of a list like this is the forked-
constant class the whole v0.5.x series has been removing; a duplicated allowlist would drift silently
and each gate would then enforce a different policy.
PATHS, NOT BASENAMES. The first version of these gates matched on basename, which would have exempted
any file called app.js or server.js anywhere in the tree. Repo-relative, forward slashes.
Both gates fail if a listed path no longer exists or has dropped below the limit, so this list shrinks
honestly and cannot rot into names nobody re-checked.

allowed.reason: MEASURED 2026-08-14 (docs/APP_JS_STATE_MODULE_PACKET.md, 'the three remaining files'): 7 of 47 top-level functions, 88 lines, reference nothing at module scope and are movable; the file reaches ~2,918. 1,199 lines sit outside any function and 585 are comments. An earlier figure of 532 lines was produced by a checker that counted only CALL targets and missed variable reads - do not use it. Clearing this file needs a redesign, not relocation; it is also the live MCP bridge, which is why the standing ruling puts it last.

RE-MEASURED 2026-08-14, and the previous reason here is WITHDRAWN (see the fourth correction in docs/APP_JS_STATE_MODULE_PACKET.md). It said clearing this file needs the 141-function render component broken - a redesign. That verdict came from a PER-FUNCTION criterion, which counts a call between two functions that would move together in the same slice as a blocker, and from treating browser globals (document/window/fetch) as blockers when an extracted .mjs runs in the same browser. The identical error had hermes-managed-host.js shelved as needing a runDeliveryLoop redesign; measured as a group it went 1,846 -> 728 with no redesign. Measured as groups here: renderAll reaches 54 functions / 1,484 lines needing only apiBase, byId, chatController and state; setPage 25 / 931. `state` now has an owner (state.mjs, with an identity gate). This file stays listed only until the byId/apiBase owners and the subject slices behind them land - it is being worked, not ruled unreachable.
